title: A Discovery of Witches
author: Deborah Harkness
summary: Diana Bishop is a historian and a witch who avoids magic. When she calls up a bewitched manuscript in an Oxford library, she attracts the attention of creatures of every kind, including a vampire geneticist.
readIf: you like scholarly, romantic fantasy with libraries, old secrets and a slow-building love story.
skipIf: you want a fast plot, since there are long stretches of travel, dinners and background detail.

pairings.reason: Another long, romantic story that mixes history, danger and a couple whose bond is tested by their worlds.
A bookish, slow-moving hunt through libraries and old records for something vampiric.
A softer, more atmospheric tale of magic and romance, with beautiful descriptions.
